mapper.select: SELECT r.rank_name AS rankName, p.position_name AS positionName FROM users u LEFT JOIN title t ON t.user_no=u.user_no LEFT JOIN rank r ON t.rank_no = r.rank_no LEFT JOIN position p ON t.position_no = p.position_no WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo}
SELECT status_no AS statusNo, status_name AS statusName, icon FROM status
SELECT s.status_name FROM users u JOIN status s ON u.status_no = s.status_no WHERE u.user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT user_no AS userNo, is_alarm_on AS isAlarmOn, allow_event_invitation AS allowEventInvitation, allow_attendance_response AS allowAttendanceResponse, allow_task_assignment AS allowTaskAssignment, allow_task_completion AS allowTaskCompletion FROM alarmsetting WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
select * from todo where user_no=#{userNo} order by end_date desc
select * from organization where user_no=#{userNo} order by input_date desc
